19 def capture_dispatch(cwd):
20     """Capture the exact dispatched campaign, without discovering a parent."""
21     try:
22         if not cwd or not (Path(cwd) / "roadmap.json").is_file():
23             return None
24         return capture_context(cwd)
25     except Exception as exc:
26         return {
27             "ok": False,
28             "error": "dispatch-context-failed",
29             "message": f"Could not capture refinement dispatch context: {exc}",
30         }

33 def record_terminal(rec):
34     """Record an observed job terminal state through the shared handoff ledger."""
35     try:
36         if rec.get("metadata_only") is True:
37             # Server-labelled summary jobs retain ordinary job/usage records.
38             # They do not produce campaign work for a human to inspect.
39             return None
40         status = rec.get("status")
41         if status not in {"done", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted"}:
42             return None
43         campaign_dir = (
44             rec.get("refinement_dir")
45             or rec.get("effort_dir")
46             or rec.get("folder_path")
47         )
48         if not campaign_dir or not (Path(campaign_dir) / "roadmap.json").is_file():
49             return None
50         job_id = rec.get("job_id")
51         result = record_handoff(
52             campaign_dir,
53             producer_kind="job",
54             producer_id=job_id,
55             source_ref=f"Anchor job {job_id}",
56             context=rec.get("refinement_context"),
57             terminal=status,
58         )
59         try:
60             from . import horizon as _horizon
61             # W3 (2026-09-28): the line follows a run's end — produced, or stalled when it failed
62             _horizon.refresh(campaign_dir, "produced" if status == "done" else "stalled")
63         except Exception:
64             pass
65         if (
66             isinstance(result, dict)
67             and result.get("ok")
68             and (result.get("skipped") or result.get("managed") is False)
69         ):
70             return {
71                 **result,
72                 "ok": False,
73                 "error": "campaign-not-managed",
74                 "skipped": True,
75                 "message": "No managed campaign ledger handoff was recorded.",
76             }
77         return result
78     except Exception as exc:
79         return {
80             "ok": False,
81             "error": "job-handoff-failed",
82             "message": f"Could not record the job terminal handoff: {exc}",
83         }

86 _PRODUCERS = frozenset({"job", "conversation", "terminal"})
87 _CONTEXT_FIELDS = ("round", "requirements", "candidate", "depends_on")

90 def _failure(message):
91     return {"ok": False, "error": "invalid-producer-handoff", "message": message}

94 def _read(campaign_dir):
95     result = refinement_client.read_state(campaign_dir)
96     if not isinstance(result, dict) or type(result.get("ok")) is not bool:
97         return {"ok": False, "error": "invalid-refinement-state", "message": "The refinement reader returned an invalid response."}
98     if result["ok"] is False:
99         return result
100     state = result.get("state")
101     if not isinstance(state, dict) or type(state.get("managed")) is not bool:
102         return {"ok": False, "error": "invalid-refinement-state", "message": "The refinement reader returned an invalid state."}
103     if type(result.get("sequence")) is not int or result["sequence"] < 0:
104         return {"ok": False, "error": "invalid-refinement-state", "message": "The refinement reader returned an invalid sequence."}
105     return result

108 def capture_context(campaign_dir, step_id=None):
109     """Capture one explicitly mapped or sole unfinished slice at dispatch."""
110     result = _read(campaign_dir)
111     if not result["ok"]:
112         return result
113     state = result["state"]
114     if not state["managed"]:
115         return None
116     slices = state.get("slices")
117     if not isinstance(slices, dict):
118         return None
119     if step_id is not None:
120         if not isinstance(step_id, str) or step_id not in slices:
121             return None
122         selected = step_id
123     else:
124         unfinished = [key for key, value in slices.items()
125                       if isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("phase") != "done"]
126         if len(unfinished) != 1:
127             return None
128         selected = unfinished[0]
129     slice_state = slices[selected]
130     if not isinstance(slice_state, dict):
131         return None
132     return {"step_id": selected, **{key: deepcopy(slice_state.get(key)) for key in _CONTEXT_FIELDS}}

135 def _handoff_id(producer_kind, producer_id):
136     encoded = json.dumps([producer_kind, producer_id], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
137     return "producer-handoff-" + hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
138 
139 
140 def _existing(result, handoff_id):
141     handoffs = result["state"].get("producer_handoffs")
142     if not isinstance(handoffs, dict) or handoff_id not in handoffs:
143         return None
144     return {"ok": True, "idempotent": True, "handoff_id": handoff_id,
145             "handoff": deepcopy(handoffs[handoff_id]), "sequence": result["sequence"]}
146

148 def _error_code(result):
149     error = result.get("error") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
150     return error.get("code") if isinstance(error, dict) else error
151

153 def _capture_warning(context):
154     code = _error_code(context)
155     if not isinstance(code, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}", code):
156         code = "dispatch-context-unavailable"
157     return {"error": code}
158

160 def _with_context_warning(result, warning):
161     return {**result, "context_warning": dict(warning)} if warning is not None and isinstance(result, dict) else result

164 def record_handoff(campaign_dir, producer_kind, producer_id, source_ref,
165                    context=None, outputs=None, inventory_complete=False, terminal="done"):
166     """Record one idempotent handoff; retry a CAS conflict at most once."""
167     context_warning = None
168     if isinstance(context, dict) and context.get("ok") is False:
169         # A dispatch-time read failure does not erase work that subsequently
170         # completed. Preserve the diagnostic code, without presenting the
171         # failure envelope as a snapshot or copying private diagnostic text.
172         context_warning = _capture_warning(context)
173         context = None
174     if not isinstance(producer_kind, str) or producer_kind not in _PRODUCERS:
175         return _failure("The producer kind must be job, conversation, or terminal.")
176     if not isinstance(producer_id, str) or not producer_id.strip():
177         return _failure("A stable producer ID is required.")
178     if context is not None:
179         if not isinstance(context, dict) or not isinstance(context.get("step_id"), str) or not context["step_id"]:
180             return _failure("Dispatch context must identify its captured step.")
181         if any(key not in context for key in _CONTEXT_FIELDS):
182             return _failure("Dispatch context must retain its complete captured state.")
183     if outputs is not None and not isinstance(outputs, list):
184         return _failure("The output inventory must be an explicit list.")
185     if type(inventory_complete) is not bool:
186         return _failure("Inventory completeness must be explicit.")
187     if not isinstance(terminal, str) or not terminal:
188         return _failure("The producer terminal state is required.")
189 
190     result = _read(campaign_dir)
191     if not result["ok"]:
192         return _with_context_warning(result, context_warning)
193     if not result["state"]["managed"]:
194         return _with_context_warning({"ok": True, "skipped": True, "reason": "unmanaged"}, context_warning)
195     identifier = _handoff_id(producer_kind, producer_id)
196     existing = _existing(result, identifier)
197     if existing is not None:
198         return _with_context_warning(existing, context_warning)
199 
200     operation = {
201         "action": "producer_handoff", "version": 1,
202         "operation_id": identifier, "handoff_id": identifier,
203         "expected_seq": result["sequence"],
204         "step_id": context["step_id"] if context is not None else None,
205         "producer_kind": producer_kind, "source_ref": deepcopy(source_ref),
206         "dispatch_context": deepcopy(context),
207         "outputs": deepcopy(outputs) if outputs is not None else [],
208         "inventory_complete": inventory_complete, "terminal": terminal,
209     }
210     if context_warning is not None:
211         operation["dispatch_error"] = context_warning["error"]
212     outcome = refinement_client.update(campaign_dir, operation)
213     conflict = _error_code(outcome)
214     if not isinstance(outcome, dict) or outcome.get("ok") is not False or conflict not in {"sequence-conflict", "HANDOFF_EXISTS"}:
215         return _with_context_warning(outcome, context_warning)
216 
217     # Re-read only to establish whether this exact handoff already committed
218     # and obtain a new CAS sequence.  Never refresh its dispatch-time context.
219     refreshed = _read(campaign_dir)
220     if not refreshed["ok"]:
221         return _with_context_warning(refreshed, context_warning)
222     if not refreshed["state"]["managed"]:
223         return _with_context_warning(outcome, context_warning)
224     existing = _existing(refreshed, identifier)
225     if existing is not None:
226         return _with_context_warning(existing, context_warning)
227     if conflict == "HANDOFF_EXISTS":
228         return _with_context_warning(outcome, context_warning)
229     retried = {**operation, "expected_seq": refreshed["sequence"]}
230     return _with_context_warning(refinement_client.update(campaign_dir, retried), context_warning)
